top_signals.title: Trump, Xi Agreed on AI Limits in Military Action, Bessent Says
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping agreed that artificial intelligence should never be allowed to make autonomous major military actions, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday.

top_signals.title: AI's Impact on Job-Loss is 'Quite Limited' Right Now, Says Dr. Homkes
top_signals.summary:
Jobless claims continue to suggest economy-wide layoffs remain low. 
Even as companies increasingly use AI and automation to operate with fewer workers, it hasn't translated into a broad pickup in layoffs.
Rebecca Homkes, Lecturer at London Business School, discusses the AI trade and how buildout has impacted jobs and productivity. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Norway’s Gas Sales Surge Nearly 20% as Europe Braces for Winter
top_signals.summary: Norway’s daily gas sales jumped nearly 20% in October and were 5.6% above year-earlier levels. The rebound comes as the EU heads into winter with its gas storage facilities less than 70% full. Norway sold 11 billion cubic meters of natural gas in October, up 2.1 billion cubic meters from September, according to preliminary figures from the Norwegian Offshore Directorate. Daily sales averaged 355.6 million cubic meters, up from a revised 296.8 million in September and 2.2% above the regulator’s forecast. EU gas storage was 69.8% full…
